content:
**Bees** are creatures found in swarms throughout Appalachia.

Scout Leader Jaggy notes that before the Great War, approximately one third of all food consumed by humans was the result of honey bee pollination. [1] 

Bees are creatures that congregate and travel in swarms. These swarms can be seen surrounding beehives, which are found on the exterior of trees, rock faces, and outbuildings. One swarm gets released from a hive whenever honey or honeycomb is taken from it. Honey Beasts have small beehives on their backs, and release bee swarms upon being attacked.

The swarm is made of several bees that attack the player character on sight.
